hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools (YES/NO outcome tokens) that implements VALS (Volatility-Adjusted Liquidity Sensitivity) dynamic pricing. Requires a backend-signed sigma parameter per swap to compute an exponential fee captured from the USDC collateral side and distributed to share holders via a YieldDistributor; swaps are blocked when the market is resolved or disputed.
